rounds.text: The market is completely missing a powerful operational inflection that is visible in the recent numbers [E44]. Compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months has surged to 47%, completely breaking away from historical stagnation and proving that demand is turning a corner [E16]. This explosive top-line acceleration is directly driving bottom-line expansion, triggering specific screens for profit growth exceeding 20% year-over-year and general earnings growth acceleration [E53, E55]. Because profit growth is currently exceeding one-year price growth by 38%, the stock is fundamentally lagging behind its rapidly improving operational reality and starting to outperform expectations [E44]. Conceded: the longer-term historical sales growth paints a much weaker picture, with compound metrics over 5 and 10 years lingering in negative or near-zero territory, alongside a zero dividend yield [E3, E13, E14]. However, valuation and sector benchmarks must be viewed through this lens of high-beta operational turnaround rather than static backward-looking multiples [E1, E5].
